annotation.title_clean: Ministerio de Ciencia impulsa diálogo transversal para una Ley de Inteligencia Artificial con amplio respaldo
annotation.title_en: Ministry of Science promotes cross-sector dialogue for an Artificial Intelligence Law with broad support
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología, Conocimiento e Innovación (MinCiencia), Chile
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Chilean Ministry of Science press release (5 Aug 2025) on the Chamber of Deputies' general approval of the AI regulation bill, which moves to the Future Commission. It stresses multi-stakeholder dialogue with industry, academia and civil society, and alignment with UNESCO and OECD principles.
key_provisions_or_claims: Chamber of Deputies approved the AI bill in general; it proceeds to the Future, Science and Technology Commission, then the Senate.
Bill introduced 7 May 2024 under President Boric and merged with a parliamentary proposal.
Ministry convenes an industry dialogue table and an expert working group.
Bill draws on UNESCO and OECD principles and sets rules for AI developers, deployers and sellers.
2023-24 consultations with UNESCO to update the National AI Policy involved over 300 participants.
